name: hud_ui_slot_draw
description: HudUiSlot::Draw dispatches the slot widget and track-marker widget draw callbacks when each embedded widget is visible.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. The body dispatches through embedded HudUiWidget virtual methods, so final byte matching should be checked with the HUD slot/widget source cluster.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40db90 tests bit 0x10 in slotWidget.flags and trackMarkerWidget.flags, and calls virtual slot 1 from each embedded widget only when the bit is clear.
The embedded HudUiWidget draw slot is owned by the functionally equivalent HudUiWidget::Draw contract under target hud_ui_widget_draw.
The native slot draw smoke installs a test draw callback in slot 1, verifies both embedded widgets draw when visible, then verifies each hidden flag suppresses only the corresponding widget draw.
